title: Is there a better way to do this? (moving pictures in relation to player)

posts.author: Kalaxi
posts.body:
So I'm trying to make a Fishing mini-game, and I wanted to have a fishing line attach to the player (who i transformed into the fishing hook,) this is just in testing so there's no exit or stop commands and what-not, but below you can see the event I have that controls the fishing line, which is just a picture, then i use the move picture command.
This
works,
but it doesnt seem like the best option? I dont know for certain but it just seems inefficient. Also it takes a little to start moving so it lags behind a little when the player moves.
I'd be okay with a little bit of lagging behind, it doesnt need to be perfect, but would still like it to be better then this. I'm mainly here asking if anyone know if there's any plugin that can either move a picture relative to a player, or maybe a script that does the same thing just more efficiently? (sorry idk any java script.)

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: How about, merge the line and the hook into a single character? It saves a lot of troubles。
